_what: Document counts read live from each review page's own database on claude.ai, using the Artifact data tooling. Python cannot reach those databases, so this file is how the counts get into scripts/session_status_report.py. Re-read the pages and rewrite this file whenever Gil says he has done more reviewing.

20260915_084812_103710_concat._note: Gil reported this review finished on 2026-11-16. 322 of 465 units carry a verdict; the 143 without are 134 Kilosort-mua and 9 Kilosort-good.

_fields: verdicts / merge_verdicts / trial_selections are document counts read live from the page's database. review_finished is Gil's own word for 'I am done with this session', which is not the same as every unit carrying a verdict -- he stops when what is left is automatic MUA he does not intend to label.
